morning.title: Your morning ritual
morning.intro: Two essentials, mist and gel, plus an optional lip balm. About three minutes, and light enough to sit under sunscreen or make-up.

steps.title: Rose Hydrating Mist
steps.how: Hold about 20 cm away and spray two or three times over a clean face and neck. Wait a few seconds.
steps.why: A little water and freshness after washing your face.

steps.title: Pure Aloe Vera Gel
steps.how: Smooth a pea-sized amount over face and neck while the mist is still slightly damp.
steps.why: Light hydration that does not feel heavy under sunscreen.

steps.title: Beetroot & Ghee Lip Balm
steps.why: Keeps lips soft through the day, with a light tint.

swaps.label: Oily or combination skin
swaps.text: Use Tea Tree Purifying Mist in step 1.

swaps.label: Hot, humid days
swaps.text: Use Eucalyptus Soothing Mist in step 1.

swaps.label: Drier skin
swaps.text: Use Aloe Vera Gel with Vitamin E in step 2.

morning.gaps: Use your usual gentle face wash before the ritual, and finish with a broad-spectrum sunscreen. These are not included in the kit.

evening.title: Your evening ritual
evening.intro: A slower routine for the end of the day. Cleanse, mist, then let an oil do its work overnight. Steps 4 and 5 matter most in winter.

steps.title: Aloe Vera Bathing Bar
steps.how: Lather between wet hands, wash face and body, rinse with lukewarm water.
steps.why: A gentle bar for face and body.

steps.title: Rose Hydrating Mist
steps.how: Spray once or twice over face and neck.
steps.why: The same bottle as your morning ritual.

steps.title: Cold-Pressed Moringa Oil
steps.how: Warm two or three drops between your palms and press onto face and neck.
steps.why: Night is the best time for an oil: it has hours to soften skin.

steps.title: Avocado & Olive Ghee Foot Butter
steps.how: Massage into heels, then wear cotton socks.
steps.why: Our older customers reorder this one for dry, cracked heels.

swaps.label: Prefer a gel at night
swaps.text: Use Aloe Vera Gel with Vitamin E instead of the oil in step 3.

swaps.label: Very dry skin in winter
swaps.text: Use the Cow Milk Bathing Bar for your body in step 1.

evening.gaps: Evening essentials covers the oil and lip balm. The complete ritual adds the bathing bar, mist and foot butter. If your skin is oily, one drop of oil is enough, or skip it and use the aloe gel.
